short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: I only have 12 V, I need 8 V!
short_scenes.narration: Volt needs eight volts, but he only has a twelve volt battery.
Two resistors in series share the voltage in proportion. One kilo-ohm and two kilo-ohms: watch, four volts and eight volts.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Twelve times two thousand over three thousand gives exactly eight volts.
